title: All lifecycle and terminal states are defined and reachable
statement: The lifecycle must expose declared to armed to active to closing to closed, with expired, revoked, and evidence-incomplete as terminal states, and must define which transitions are legal from each state.

source.reference: packet.md (the lifecycle exposes declared, armed, active, closing, closed; expired, revoked, and evidence-incomplete are terminal); interface-bridge.md REF-002; anchors: XVE-SYS-0152, FR-018

verification_intent: Unit: full transition table (legal and illegal pairs); terminal-state lockout; assert resulting state values and rejection codes.
acceptance_criteria: Each state is reachable via its defined operation from its predecessor.
Terminal states admit no outgoing transition and attempts are rejected deterministically.
Invalid transitions such as declared to active are rejected without mutation.
Expiry and revocation can be applied from the states where they are legal.
